name: yiioffice
description: Office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf, markdown)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/zip-gate && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @yiioffice/markdown
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @yiioffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @yiioffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @yiioffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @yiioffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @yiioffice/markdown" "cross-env DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 npm run dev -w @yiioffice/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @yiioffice/docs && npm run build -w @yiioffice/sheets && npm run build -w @yiioffice/slides && npm run build -w @yiioffice/pdf && npm run build -w @yiioffice/markdown && npm run build -w @yiioffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @yiioffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @yiioffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build -w @yiioffice/sheets && npm run dist:win -w @yiioffice/shell
scripts.dist:win:installer: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build -w @yiioffice/sheets && npm run dist:win:installer -w @yiioffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @yiioffice/shell
